title: Automated Archival Descriptions with Federated Intelligence of LLMs

live_model.evidence: "LLM 2 (GPT-4-turbo from OpenAI)", one of four LLMs generating ISAD(G) archival metadata; "LLM 1 performed the best, followed by LLM 3, LLM 2, and finally LLM 4" (Figure 3).

claim.metric: ISAD(G) metadata quality score, GPT-4-turbo (figure only, no printed value)
claim.location: Figure 3 (bar chart; exact GPT-4-turbo score not printed as text, only its rank: 3rd of 4)

notes: GPT-4-turbo's individual ISAD(G) score is reported only graphically (Figure 3); text gives only its rank ordering and a couple of anchor values for the best/worst models (LLM 1 and LLM 4), not GPT-4-turbo's own number. Scoring methodology (how metadata quality is scored 0-1) not confirmed, possibly LLM-judged.
